Name: Keyboard Only
Author: GhostGoesBinted
Description:
[size=6]Keyboard‑Only Mode for Stardew Valley
[/size]
[size=3][i]Confirm menus with Enter/Space, cycle tools with Q/E, and forget the mouse. Lightweight, simple, and fully configurable.
[/i][/size]


[b][size=4]Mod: ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿    Vanilla:[/size][/b]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/tpNQFn7m/2025-08-2410-49-57-ezgif-com-optimize-2.gif[/img][/url]     [url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/xSk1B0xX/2025-08-2410-40-02-ezgif-com-video-to-gif-converter-1.gif[/img]

[/url]

[b][size=4][u]Features
[/u][/size][/b][list]
[*][b]Custom Confirm Keys[/b] – Press your chosen key (default: Ent/Spc) to confirm in menus (acts like a left-click).
[*][b]Secondary Action Key[/b] – Perform right-click actions in menus with a single key (default:c)
[*][b]Toolbar Cycling[/b] – Cycle through your toolbar outside of menus (default: Q/E)
[*][b]Smart Cursor Reset[/b] – Your cursor automatically moves to the bottom-right edge when menus close.
[/list][list]
﻿[/list][size=5][b][u]In‑game options (important)[/u]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=5][b]Turn ON “Use controller‑style menus”.[/b][/size]
[*][size=5][b]Set “Gamepad mode” to “Force on”.[/b][/size]
[/list][b][size=3]
These enable focus/snapping so confirm works reliably from the keyboard.[/size][/b]


[b][u][size=4]Install[/size][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest SMAPI[/url] ﻿
[*]Download this mod, then either install it with your preferred mod manager or unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[u][size=4][b]Config[/b]
[/size][/u]If you install Generic Mod Config Menu you can change all options in‑game.
﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/xttVjgGv/image.png[/img]


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[i][size=2]My personal controls:
[/size][/i][list]
[*][i][size=2]Z for confirm/LMB[/size][/i]
[*][size=2][i]X for RMB[/i][/size]
[*][i][size=2]Arrow keys for movement[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=2]Tab/E to Open Inventory/Close Menu[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=2]Cycle Tools Q/W[/size][/i]
[/list][size=2][i]
